title: Crypt Trio
description: A blonde woman in a black off-shoulder gown with a crown stands in the center of a stone archway, flanked by a blue horned demon-like figure and a bandaged mummy. They stand in an ancient torch-lit crypt corridor with carved runes on the walls and bats flying around them.
prompt: A dramatic scene inside an ancient stone crypt with carved runes and flaming torches on the walls. In the center stands a beautiful blonde woman wearing a black off-shoulder gown with red lining, fishnet stockings, high heels and a golden crown. To her left is a muscular blue-skinned demon with curved horns and tribal tattoos wearing a black cape. To her right is a fully wrapped mummy in decaying bandages. Bats fly around the arched hallway, dark gothic atmosphere, cinematic lighting.
